performance.verdict: Paid is fully dark 12 days; pipeline shows zero opps despite 33 contacts.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 for 12 consecutive days (Aug 6–17); all 45 leads and $1,171.64 spend came from the prior active period.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17) vs prior 3 (Aug 12–14): sc_clicks collapsed from avg 23.3 to avg 3.3, a 86% drop — organic search momentum is fading fast with paid dark.
GHL shows 33 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — leads from the active period are not entering the pipeline; this is an intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions down 23.4% WoW and ig_reach near zero (avg 0.3 last 7 days vs 85 prior) — brand presence collapsing across all organic touchpoints while paid is offline.
GA4 sessions spiked to 206 on Aug 13 then dropped to 13 on Aug 16 — likely a one-day referral or direct anomaly; directional only given known double-count issue.

suggestions.text: Relaunch 'CROA || CBO - 3/17/26' at its last active daily budget (~$69/day) to restore lead flow immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been fully dark for 12 days (Aug 6–17), with $0 spend and 0 leads generated. Relaunch 'CROA || CBO - 3/17/26' at approximately $69/day, matching the last active daily spend average before shutdown. Success is confirmed when CPL returns to or below the 28-day baseline of $26.04 within 7 days of relaunch (by 2026-08-25).

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 33 contacts logged but 0 opportunities created — identify where contacts are stalling before any ad spend resumes.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 33 contacts from the active paid period but zero opportunities created and zero appointments booked, meaning leads are arriving but not entering the pipeline. Review the GHL workflow and contact stage automation to identify the breakpoint — this is an intake process failure, not an ads problem. Success is confirmed when newly arriving contacts from the relaunched campaign (S1) begin generating opportunities within the first week, targeting at least 5 opportunities created by 2026-08-25.

suggestions.text: Watch sc_clicks for 3 days post-relaunch; if avg stays below 10/day, organic search health needs separate investigation.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks averaged 23.3/day Aug 12–14 but collapsed to 3.3/day over the last 3 days, coinciding with paid going dark. Monitor sc_clicks daily starting at relaunch. If the 3-day average does not recover above 12 clicks/day by 2026-08-25, escalate for a separate organic/GSC investigation beyond the paid relaunch.
